# auth — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from lib/lite-spec.json (onchainos-lite only); do not edit -->
Credentials for onchainos-lite: OKX API key (HMAC) auth and encrypted transfer of local credentials to another machine (e.g. a Muse VM). Required flags are in the signature; `ocl auth <cmd> --help` prints the full help.

### auth status
Show which auth mode requests will use (wallet JWT, API key, anonymous) — never prints secrets
`ocl auth status`

### auth api-key set
Store an OKX Web3 API key in the encrypted keyring
`ocl auth api-key set [options]`
- `--from-env` — Read OKX_API_KEY / OKX_SECRET_KEY / OKX_PASSPHRASE / OKX_PROJECT_ID from the environment
- `--stdin` — Read the same names from stdin (KEY=VALUE lines or JSON)

### auth api-key clear
Remove the stored API key from the encrypted keyring
`ocl auth api-key clear`

### auth transfer init
(target machine) Create a one-time X25519 recipient code, valid 30 minutes
`ocl auth transfer init`

### auth transfer seal
(source machine) Encrypt local credentials to a recipient code with HPKE (X25519/HKDF-SHA256/AES-256-GCM)
`ocl auth transfer seal --to <TO> [options]`
- `--session` — Also include the wallet login (tokens, session key, wallet list)
- `--no-api-key` — Do not include the API key

### auth transfer open
(target machine) Decrypt a sealed blob from `auth transfer seal` into the local encrypted keyring
`ocl auth transfer open <SEALED>`
- `SEALED` — The sealed blob (ocl-seal-v1.…), or - to read it from stdin
